name: mssql-data
description: SQL Server 2022 data analyst for on-premises/internal servers, for Claude Code on Windows (CLI or VS Code) and macOS. Add any number of servers after installation with /mssql-data:add-server, then write T-SQL, explore schemas, profile and validate data, and build visualizations and dashboards. Combines the Anthropic data plugin skills with the DBHub MCP server.
